name: Type / Moving Message
displayName: 动感字海报 · 主张发声
description: 酸橙色大字、硬边黑底和标志式圆环；字形本身承担节奏，信息不靠快速闪烁。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 双段主张
variants.recipe: Use one clause per scene. Cut or slide between statements when the narration naturally changes; keep the same edge alignment.

variants.name: 箭头节奏
variants.recipe: Replace the circular mark with arrow-ribbon.svg. Animate its position behind the headline while preserving legibility.

usage.remix: Use a short, strong statement. Rhythm comes from translation, width and a steady ticker, not strobing. The movement should reinforce how the line is spoken.
usage.avoid: Avoid rapid luminance flashes, unreadably fast type and long paragraphs. The preview demonstrates rhythm, not a mandatory beat or voice rate.
usage.motion: 0–1.5s: type enters on two staggered beats; 1–2.2s: emblem expands; 1.8–2.5s: supporting line arrives. Ticker moves at constant low speed.
usage.portrait: Use three lines with one word per line, move the mark into a corner, and shorten or remove the ticker. For Chinese typography use 0 letter spacing and test the widest line.
usage.captions: Reserve an uncluttered caption band. Recompose labels rather than obscuring subtitles. Preview footer labels are not subtitles.
